_experiment_choices.experiment: Adaptation pilot (docs/ct_ph_sac_layout.md, Adaptation experiment): the runs of the final acrobot-swingup irregular row (2026-11-12_r5), trained to 500k decisions, continue on a robot whose lower link is 25% longer. This file: arms 1 and 2, the paper arms ct_sac_torque and implicit_torque, each warm-started from its own runs (g_acrobot_swingup, gt_acrobot_swingup), the implicit arm with every part of the plant trainable; run with --arms ct_sac_torque implicit_torque, and add implicit_learned_admissions for the impedance-law arm warm-started the same way from its runs (g_acrobot_swingup)
_experiment_choices.testbed_settings.physical_change: kind length, scale 1.25: l2 1.0 -> 1.25 m, the capsule's mass m2 (1 kg) and radius kept, so MuJoCo compiles the centre of mass at 0.625 m and the inertia from the new geometry (common.ph_dmc.acrobot.acrobot_physical_change). The reward stays the nominal robot's function of the state (the Lyapunov energy of the 1 m link and the row's constants); no learner is told the change
_experiment_choices.protocol.warm_start: checkpoint.pt of each source run, seed for seed (the run's training seed is the source's); require_interactions 500000 refuses an intermediate checkpoint of a run still in progress. Loaded: actor, critics and targets (CT-SAC); actor, rate head, value and target, online and admitted plant, learned reward (implicit); the tuned temperature. Fresh: optimizers, replay (empty), counters, schedules; warm-up and the implicit warm fit skipped
_experiment_choices.protocol.interaction_budget: 100000 decisions on the changed robot, counted from 0
_experiment_choices.protocol.evaluation_every_interactions: 2500 (about 1.2 training episodes at the irregular clock's 2036 decisions per 10 s episode), dense enough to time the recovery; the evaluation at 0 scores the source policy on the changed robot before any update
_experiment_choices.training.plant_step_dense_until: 100000 as the row: the interaction count restarts at 0, so the implicit plant takes a step on every row for the whole pilot, as the from-scratch control does
_experiment_choices.everything else: the acrobot-swingup row of mode irregular (benchmarks/hyperparams/ct_ph_sac.csv), as the source runs
